title: The other gas crossing
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Carbon dioxide diffuses from pulmonary capillary blood into alveolar air under the usual partial-pressure gradient. It can then leave the body in exhaled air.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain co₂ diffuses from blood to alveolar air in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: At the lung, where does carbon dioxide move from pulmonary capillary blood under the usual gradient? Carbon dioxide diffuses from pulmonary capillary blood into alveolar air under the usual partial-pressure gradient. It can then leave the body in exhaled air.
